blocks.label: Suggested use
paragraphs: 9 years and up: As a dietary supplement, take one (1) gummy per day. Chew thoroughly before swallowing.

blocks.label: Other ingredients
paragraphs: Glucose syrup, sugar, water, pectin, black carrot concentrate (color), citric acid, trisodium citrate, natural flavor, carnauba wax.
Does not contain eggs, wheat (gluten), milk, peanuts, tree nuts, sesame, soy or shellfish.
Processed in a nut free facility.

blocks.label: Warnings
paragraphs: Do not exceed suggested serving size. If you have a medical condition, are taking medication, or are pregnant or nursing, ask a doctor before using.
Not for children under 2 years of age due to risk of choking.
Do not use this product if safety seal under cap is torn or missing.
Keep out of reach of children.
Store at room temperature. Avoid excessive heat.
